extract_session_episode.py --preserve has two gaps this branch hit. It keeps a commit event whose SHA is reachable from zero refs, although the same file's _sha_is_reachable already implements that filter for commit-order validation. And _merge_metrics takes a per-key max, so metrics.commits cannot follow the event stream downward when an event is removed; it had to be lowered by hand. Both need their own issue and a code change, so neither belongs in this rule-only PR.
